outputs.explanation: Panel A is a Western blot image, not a plot showing averaged data.
Bar charts (pFoxO3(Ser253)/FoxO3 and pFoxO3(Thr32)/FoxO3) show mean ± SEM with error bars but no overlaid individual data points.
Bar chart of pAKT(Thr308)/AKT shows mean ± SEM only, without individual data points overlaid.
Panel D is a Western blot image, not a plot showing averaged data.
Bar charts of pFoxO3(Ser253)/FoxO3 and pFoxO3(Thr32)/FoxO3 fold change show mean with error bars but no individual data points.
Bar chart of pAKT(Thr308)/AKT fold change shows mean with error bars but lacks individual data points.
Panel G is a Western blot image, not a plot showing averaged data.
Bar charts of pFoxO3(Ser253)/FoxO3 and pFoxO3(Thr32)/FoxO3 fold change show mean with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
Bar chart of pAKT(Thr308)/AKT fold change shows mean with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
Panel J consists of representative immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
